acceptedAnswer.text: In Las Vegas, all plumbing work, including galvanized pipe replacement, must adhere to local building codes and require proper permitting to ensure safety and quality standards. CG Plumbing Solutions is familiar with Henderson and Las Vegas area regulations and handles all necessary permits. Understanding these local requirements is critical because unpermitted work can lead to fines and complications when selling your home, underscoring the importance of hiring licensed professionals.
